questions.question:
In the given questions, assuming the given statements to be true. Find which of the given two conclusions number I and II is/are definitely true and give your answer accordingly.


Statements: C < N < R > S, N < P

Conclusions:

I. P > S

II. R > C
options: If either conclusion I or II follows
If neither conclusion I nor II follows
If both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation:
I.P > S - False

From Statement - P > N < R > S 

From N < P and N <R> S, we know R > S and P > N.
We cannot directly compare P and S from given statements.

II.R > C- True 

From Statement - C < N < R 

Hence, the correct ans is "Only conclusion II follows."

questions.question:
In the given questions, assuming the given statements to be true. Find which of the given two conclusions number I and II is/are definitely true and give your answer accordingly.


Statements: G > I = J > K = L ≤ M

Conclusions:

I. I > L

II. M ≥ K
options: If either conclusion I or II follows
If neither conclusion I nor II follows
If both conclusions I and II follow
questions.explanation:
G > I = J > K = L ≤ M

That means:

  • G is greater than I

  • I = J

  • J > K

  • K = L

  • L ≤ M

So, the chain is:
G > I = J > K = L ≤ M

Conclusion I: I > L

  • I = J

  • J > K

  • K = L
    So, I = J > K = L → I > L  (True)

Conclusion II: M ≥ K

  • We know L ≤ M, and K = L.
    So, K ≤ M → which is same as M ≥ K  (True)

Final Answer:

Both conclusions follow.

Correct Option: E (If both conclusions I and II follow

Hence,  the option E is correct

as the number of birthdays between B and T.

2. G is the immediate neighbor of I and B.

3. I and A are not immediate members.

5. There is one person between H and F. H is not a immediate member of I and K.

6.There are three people between H and D. One of the neighbors of H is C.

7. E and J are immediate neighbors.

8. J sits to the immediate left of E.

K and F are immediate neighbors.

So, Case 1, Case 2, Case 1B, Case 2B is invalid.

9. E and A are not immediate neighbors.

So, Case 2A is invalid.

The final arrangement is,

In DB, EH, JC and AF the first person is seated third to the right of the second person.

In GK the first person is seated third to the left of the second person

Hence, GK is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Study the following information carefully and answer the questions accordingly.

 

Eight students are seated around a circular table, with some facing towards the centre and some facing away from it. MQ is third to the right of SQ who sits second to the left of YQ. PQ sits on the immediate right of XQ, who faces the same direction as faced by MQ. Neither XQ nor PQ is adjacent to MQ. CQ is third to the left of YQ. Not more than 4 students face outside. BQ and SQ face the same direction. CQ is third to the right of BQ. JQ is second to the left of MQ. CQ and JQ face opposite directions to that of BQ. Immediate neighbors of CQ face opposite directions.

 

Find the odd one out from the given five options?
questions.explanation:
• MQ is third to the right of SQ who sits second to the left of YQ.

  • CQ is third to the left of YQ.

Here, we can 4 cases draw;

  • PQ sits on the immediate right of XQ who faces the same direction as faced by MQ.

  • Neither XQ nor PQ is adjacent to MQ.

Case 2 and case 3 are ruled out, Further two cases arise from Case-1 and Case-4 which are named as Case-1A and Case-4A.

  • CQ is third to the right of BQ.

  • JQ is second to the left of MQ.

  • BQ and SQ face the same direction.

  • Immediate neighbors of CQ face opposite directions.

  • Not more than 4 persons face outside.

Hence, case 1A, case 4 and case 4A are ruled out;

CQ and JQ face opposite directions to that of BQ.

The final arrangement can be obtained as follows.

PQ is the odd one out as all others except PQ face towards the centre.

Hence option E is correct.

questions.question: The boat row with current and against the current in 18 hours and the ratio of the speed of boat in still water to stream is 3:1. If the distance covers a boat is 120 km, then find the downstream speed?

=702

\(? = 12096\  \times \ (100/35)\  = 34560\)

questions.question: Ratio of two numbers is 5: 4. If 30% of the smaller number is 14 more than the 20% of the larger number, then find the difference between both the numbers?

Let the larger number be 5x and the smaller number be 4x.

So,

\(4x\  \times \ \frac{30}{100}\  = \ 5x\  \times \ \frac{20}{100}\  + \ 14\)

1.2x = x + 14

x = 70

Now, the difference between both the numbers = (5 - 4) × 70 = 70

questions.question: Ratio of ages of A to B is 5: 8 and B is 7 years older to C. If sum of ages of A and C is 32 years, then find the age of C after 3 years.
questions.explanation:
Let present ages of A and B are ‘5x’ and ‘8x’ respectively.

Present age of C = 8x - 7

According to the question:

5x + (8x - 7) = 32

13x = 39

x = 3

Present age of C = 8x - 7 = 17 years

Age of C after 3 years = 17 + 3 = 20 years

questions.question: Tap A can empty a tank in 6 hours and another tap B can fill the tank at the rate of 15 lit/min. If both the taps are opened the tank can be emptied in 10 hours then find the capacity of the tank.
questions.explanation:
Let the capacity of the tank is "C" liters

According to the problem, tap A can empty the tank in 6 hours. So;

rate of tap A ,\(\ A\  = \ \frac{C}{6}\)

Tap B can fill the tank at the rate of 15 liters per minute, which is equivalent to 900 liters per hour. Therefore,

rate of tap B , \(B\  = \ 900\)

When both taps are opened, the tank can be emptied in 10 hours. Therefore;

combined rate of the taps \(= A\  - \ B\  = \ \frac{C}{10}\)

\(= > \frac{C}{6}\  - \ 900\  = \ \frac{C}{10}\)

\(= > \frac{C}{6} - \frac{C}{10}\  = \ 900\)

\(= > \frac{4C}{60} = 900\)

\(= > C\  = \ 13500\ l\)

questions.question: Rs 20790 is divided among Nobita, Zian and Sunio in such a way such that Nobita gets 80% of what Zian gets and Zian gets 66.66% of what Sunio gets. How much more or less does Sunio gets from Zian?
questions.explanation:
Given Information:

  • Total amount = Rs 20,790

  • Nobita gets 80% of Zian’s share

  • Zian gets 66.66% ( = 2/3 ) of Sunio’s share

  • Required: How much more or less Sunio gets compared to Zian'+

Calculation:

Nobita gets 80% of what Zian gets

\(\Rightarrow\)Nobita : Zian \(= 4:5\)

Zian gets 66.66% of what Sunio gets

\(\Rightarrow\)Zian : Sunio\(= 2:3\)

Equivalent ratio of Nobita, Zian and Sunio\(= 8:10:15\)

The amount Sunio gets more of Zian\(= \frac{(15 - 10)}{33} \times 20790 = 3150\)

Hence, option C is correct.

Used Concept:

  • Convert percentages into fractions

  • Convert given relations into ratios

  • Divide total amount in the obtained ratio

  • Find the difference between Sunio’s and Zian’s shares

questions.question: The average height of the first six students is 170 cm, the average height of the last eight students is 175 cm. The average height of the total 16 students is 180 cm. Find the average height of the rest two students.
questions.explanation:
Sum of the heights of the first six students = 170 × 6 = 1020 cm
Sum of the heights of the last eight students = 175 × 8 = 1400 cm
Sum of the heights of the total 16 students = 180 × 16 = 2880
Sum of the height of the left 2 students = 2880 – 1020 – 1400 = 460

Average height of the left 2 students = \(\frac{460}{2}\) = 230 cm
